prompt: A single illustration shows a circular assembly-line loop in which an AI agent repeatedly improves its work: on one side, a model writes code; next, a small renderer displays the resulting webpage or game screen; then a magnifying eye or inspection lens examines the visual output and marks a visible error; after that, a tool-equipped hand edits the code; and the cycle returns to rendering again, with several faint repeated versions arranged around the loop like drafts. A person is present only as a distant supervisor, emphasizing long autonomous revision. Around the loop, the scaffolding, screens, connectors, and tools are drawn as prominently as the central model, showing that the surrounding harness is essential; the overall image should read as iterative drafting and checking rather than a single question-and-answer exchange.
